environment: dirty local working tree and loopback synthetic preview
applicability_reason: The web runtime contains no AI inference, but the content-production process uses an external generative system. Provider/deployer role, system introduction date and machine-readable marking responsibility are not established by the repository.
expected: Classify each actor and date under the current consolidated AI Act and preserve provider provenance/marking evidence where the applicable transparency branch requires it.
observed: Every inspected city/profile image is visibly labelled as AI-generated and the profile is expressly fictitious. No machine-readable provenance or external provider compliance record is present in the repository.
method: Static source review, visual inspection of current screenshots and official EUR-Lex verification of the 2026 consolidated AI Act.
limitations: No Gemini/Nano Banana provider contract, generation metadata or system introduction date was available.
This audit does not assign the website operator the AI provider obligations of article 50(2).
impact: The visible disclosure is helpful, but the operator cannot demonstrate whether the relevant provider/deployer transparency duties and transition dates were met.
prevalence: All synthetic profile, service and city media.

source_refs.legal_effect: Direct obligations depend on actor role, AI-system scope and staged application dates; article 50(2) addresses provider marking of synthetic outputs.
source_refs.instrument: Reglamento (UE) 2024/1689 de Inteligencia Artificial, modificado por Reglamento (UE) 2026/1744
source_refs.applicability_reason: External generative content production creates a role/date/provenance question, but no runtime AI system or role allocation is proven in the repository.
source_refs.verification_method: Official EUR-Lex consolidated text, article 50 and transition/application provisions review.

false_positive_analysis: The visible label may exceed what is required of a mere website publisher, and static fictional imagery is not automatically a deep fake. The finding is therefore role/provenance uncertainty, not a nonconformity claim.
counterevidence: Profiles say PERFIL FICTICIO GENERADO CON IA.
Images are visibly labelled Generada con IA / IMAGEN GENERADA CON IA.
The current preview is not authorised for publication.
remediation_minimum: Preserve generation provenance and provider terms; obtain a role/date assessment under the current AI Act; retain visible disclosure and verify any applicable machine-readable marking before public use.
additional_hardening: Store C2PA or equivalent provenance metadata when supplied and include its verification status in the asset manifest without stripping it during optimisation.
suggested_owner: Content operations, legal counsel and media pipeline engineering
retest: Inspect original and optimised assets, provider evidence, actor classification and the then-current article 50 transition.
residual_risk: Moderate until role and provenance are documented; visible consumer-facing disclosure already reduces deception risk.
